6.q: Give the correct order of pillars in a reform plan that uses technology, accountability and community monitoring to cut PDS leakage.
6.a: The reform pillars run: (1) Aadhaar-seeded ration cards with ePoS devices at every fair price shop delete ghost cards (2) One Nation One Ration Card portability lets migrants draw grain anywhere (3) Vigilance Committees under the NFSA fix institutional accountability (4) Social audits open the stock registers to community monitoring. A wrong answer that relies on a single pillar shows the student has missed that leakage needs authentication, accountability and vigilance working together.

3.q: With agriculture at 18 percent of GDP employing 42 percent of workers, and non-agriculture at 82 percent of GDP employing 58 percent, calculate the approximate ratio of non-farm output per worker to farm output per worker.
3.a: Farm productivity works out as GDP share over workforce share, and the same for the non-farm sector: 18/42 versus 82/58, so the ratio = 3.3. A wrong answer that compares the GDP shares directly, or calls agriculture more productive because it employs more people, shows the student has missed that output per worker in agriculture is roughly one-fourth of the non-agricultural level.
